import numpy as np, math, json
def shells(q):
 return math.sqrt(9+16*math.exp(-2*q)),math.sqrt(9+16*math.exp(2*q))
def compact(q):
 x,y=shells(q)
 return np.sort(np.array([n+v for n in range(4) for v in (2*x-10,x+y-10,x+y-10,2*y-10)]))
old=np.repeat(np.arange(4),4)
max_orbit=0.
rows=[]
for q in (-2.,-.2,-.01,-1e-5,0.,1e-5,.01,.2,2.):
 x,y=shells(q); d=2*(max(x,y)-5)
 sorted_distance=float(np.max(abs(compact(q)-old)))
 max_orbit=max(max_orbit,abs(sorted_distance-d))
 assert abs(sorted_distance-d)<1e-12
 rows.append({'q':q,'sorted_orbit_distance':sorted_distance,'endpoint_formula':d})
max_affine=0.
arows=[]
for q in (-.01,-.003,.003,.01):
 x,y=shells(q); delta=abs(y-x)
 for a in (.1,.75,1.,1.4,4.):
  diff=compact(q)-a*old
  c=float((min(diff)+max(diff))/2)
  radius=float((max(diff)-min(diff))/2)
  predicted=delta+1.5*abs(1-a)
  max_affine=max(max_affine,abs(radius-predicted))
  assert abs(radius-predicted)<1e-12
  arows.append({'q':q,'a':a,'optimal_c_relative_baseline':c,'radius':radius,'profile_formula':predicted})
dx=1e-6
sx=(compact(dx)-compact(0))/dx
# Sorted derivative has q>0 ordered AB eigenvalues; every n has +-6.4 endpoints.
target=np.tile([-6.4,0.,0.,6.4],4)
source_res=float(max(abs(sx-target)))
assert source_res<1e-5
spectral_remainder=[]
for q in (.001,.01):
 x,y=shells(q); diff=np.array([2*x-10,x+y-10,x+y-10,2*y-10])
 d=max(abs(diff))
 for t in (.1,.5,2.,10.):
  exact=float(max(2*abs(np.sin(t*diff/2))))
  bound=min(2.,abs(t)*d)
  assert exact<=bound+1e-13
  spectral_remainder.append({'q':q,'t':t,'exact_full_unitary_norm':exact,'Duhamel_bound':bound})
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','orbit_max_residual':max_orbit,'affine_profile_max_residual':max_affine,
 'positive_q_source_difference_residual':source_res,'orbit':rows,'affine':arows,'wait_comparison':spectral_remainder},indent=2))
